text:
ria: quick RFC follow-up: yesterday the canary let a model through with a tokenizer variance. not catastrophic but noisy. we should add a tiny deterministic intake check to avoid wasted benches.

sam: +1. thinking of an ABI-lite check that runs inline (<25ms): compare a compact sample-hash, vocab count delta, and kv-format tag against the catalog. three outcomes: PASS, REVIEW, BLOCK.

nina: what does REVIEW mean in practice?

sam: REVIEW -> run in shadow canary, don't auto-promote; BLOCK -> stop benching and attach diff artifact for human triage. PASS -> proceed.

leo: implementation notes: make sample-hash deterministic across tokenizers by normalizing whitespace and using top-2 token ids per probe sentence. record rare-token-ratio delta too.

ria: product concern: avoid blocking internal lab experiments. suggest intake descriptor flag: "abi_mode": "enforce"|"shadow"|"off" with default enforce for hosted/dedicated.

nina: telemetry needs: emit event fast_abi.v1 with model_ref, result, diffsize, delta_vocab, latency_ms. keep payload tiny to avoid billing.

sam: rollout plan: 1) implement check + telemetry; 2) shadow run 7 days at 5% traffic; 3) run replay of BLOCKs through full bench to estimate false positives; 4) flip to enforce.

leo: ops safety: add a one-click "allow-once" in intake UI to bypass a BLOCK and log reason. also show suggested fallback model variant from catalog if available.

ria: decision: build simple lambda in intake that returns result and a 128-byte base64 diff if REVIEW/BLOCK. owners: sam protos the lambda, nina wires telemetry and replay, leo UI unblock, ria owns rollout doc.

onboard-bot: created ticket https://redwood.internal/boards/ONBOARD-4901 and scheduled shadow window 4806600000-4807260000.

sam: I'll ship a small prototype today and post PR.

nina: I'll add replay job to validate FP rate.

leo: will sketch the UI unblock flow.

ria: thanks all, sync in 30 for short check-in.
